GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2023-08-10T12:34:56Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Aggregate function last_value is found inside another aggregate function in query
Description: > If you still prefer GitHub issues, remove all this text and ask your question here.

sql:
```
SELECT 
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 day) as timestamp,
    sum(last_value(number_field_values[indexOf(number_field_keys,'iteration_requirement_total')])) as requirement_total
FROM external_metrics_all 
WHERE 
    metric_group='project_report' 
    AND timestamp >= '2023-08-08 00:00:00' 
    AND timestamp <= '2023-08-11 00:00:00' 
GROUP BY 
    tag_values[indexOf(tag_keys,'project_id')],
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 day),
    timestamp
```

execute above sql, i got error:
```
Aggregate function last_value(arrayElement(number_field_values, indexOf(number_field_keys, 'iteration_requirement_total'))) is found inside another aggregate function in query: While processing last_value(number_field_values[indexOf(number_field_keys, 'iteration_requirement_total')])
```

In clickhouse, can aggregation functions be nested?
In different projects, there will be many iterations. We upload the total number of defects of the current iteration many times a day. I want to count the total number of defects of all iterations under each project.
